en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.3521 - It is narrated by Talhah bin Zayd, from Imam Jafar ibn Muhammad Al-Sadiq (as) from his father, Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as), peace be upon him, regarding a man who freed part of his slave.
Imam (as) said: "He is completely free; there is no partner with Allah (swt), the Almighty."
